mode: Lecture seule ; clés gold→sources, en complément des liens gold→silver→bronze mesurés par lot

mesures.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(c.client_id IS NULL),0) liens_manquants FROM gold.xref_identifiants x LEFT JOIN crm.client c ON c.client_id=x.source_id WHERE x.source_systeme='crm'
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(c.column0 IS NULL),0) liens_manquants FROM gold.xref_identifiants x LEFT JOIN cif.clients c ON c.column0=x.source_id WHERE x.source_systeme='cif'
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(c.contrat_id IS NULL),0) liens_manquants FROM gold.contrat_certifie g LEFT JOIN crm.contrat c ON c.contrat_id=g.contrat_id WHERE g._batch_id='L-2026-10-01'
SELECT COUNT(*) n,COALESCE(SUM(c.sinistre_id IS NULL),0) liens_manquants FROM gold.sinistre_certifie g LEFT JOIN crm.sinistre c ON c.sinistre_id=g.sinistre_id WHERE g._batch_id='L-2026-10-01'
